subject: feat(cost): the meter says which way the fixed overhead moved
prompt:
The run-economics composition row (`summarizeRunEconomics` in packages/llm-gateway/src/run-economics.ts, printed by `rune cost` and `/cost`) reports only averages over every measured completion. Now that the opening doctrine is sent only at the start of a run, the average describes no request that was ever sent: the opening completion carries more doctrine than the ones after it, and the tool-schema share grows as catalogued tools are loaded mid-run. Nobody can tell from the report which way the fixed overhead moved.

Carry the fixed overhead — doctrine plus tool schemas — of the FIRST measured completion and of the LAST one in the composition economics, and show the pair in the cost report (packages/orchestrator/src/cost-report.ts) when they differ, e.g. `62.4KB → 56.0KB`, with a note saying whether the last call carried less or more than the first.

Rules:
- Only completions that carry a composition count. A governance call (a classifier, say) measures nothing and must never be taken for the first or the last measured call.
- With a single measured completion, both ends are the same value.

Keep the existing exported APIs working, and keep the existing tests passing; the existing fields keep their meaning.

Interface the fix must provide:
- `CompositionEconomics.fixedFirst: number` and `CompositionEconomics.fixedLast: number` — bytes of doctrine plus tool schemas on the first and on the last measured completion.
